description: This points dataset shows the locations of all listed buildings in Northern Ireland. It is published on OpenDataNI, the Northern Ireland open data portal, and listed on data.gov.uk, where the entry was last modified on 10 September 2026; the GeoJSON file name carries the same date and the shapefile download is named as the historic buildings record. The data.gov.uk entry names OpenDataNI as publisher and does not name the government department that maintains the list. Coverage is all listed buildings in Northern Ireland. Access: GeoJSON and zipped shapefile downloads. Licence: Open Government Licence per the data.gov.uk entry; free. Caveats: points only, without listing boundaries; attributes were not read because the files were not opened. Simulation uses: heritage constraints on retrofit and exposure of historic buildings to floods and storms. Related records: the England listed buildings and Historic Environment Scotland designations, which together with this cover the UK apart from Wales.
name: Listed Buildings Northern Ireland
